query: In conclusion, based on our extensive study of the blood and lymphatic vascularization of the epididymis in mice, we propose that the epididymis presents two types of lymphatic vessels. On the one hand, there are peritubular PLVAPpos hybrid vessels, very permeable, particularly well represented in the S1 compartment that, according to our hypothesis, participate both in the reabsorption function and in the immune surveillance of this territory. On the other hand, we have more conventional lymphatics mainly in the interstitial compartment.
